title: Dental PPO Plans Estimate Worksheet: Estimated Plan Payment and Patient Cost of a Requested Estimate
content:
Estimate worksheet standard, Dental PPO Plans. A pre-treatment estimate that the member requests anew (a requested estimate) is figured as follows, as if the procedure were performed on the issue date.

**A. What the request is priced on.** The procedure, benefit category, tooth or area, network status, proposed fee and recorded allowance of the request are those of the person's most recently issued estimate line (its estimated allowed amount); where several issued estimate lines share that latest issue date, this worksheet is not used. The service class is the one recorded on the person's most recent claim-line decision for the same benefit category; where several such decisions share that latest decision date this worksheet is not used, and a request for a category with no such decision is figured under the base rules.

**B. Allowance.** The lesser of the proposed fee and the allowance recorded on that estimate line.

**C. Coinsurance.** The plan's out-of-network percentage for the procedure's service class.

**D. Waiting period.** The estimate is payable only when the issue date is at least its waiting period counted in whole calendar months from the coverage effective date (a month counting as whole when the day of the month of the issue date is not earlier than that of the coverage effective date, which always falls on the first of a month). The waiting period is the one for the service class that applies to the enrollment: the plan's individual waiting period for individual and individual exchange enrollments, its late-entrant waiting period for group enrollments of a late entrant, and none for other group enrollments or for preventive services. Otherwise the estimated plan payment is 0.00.

**E. Missing-tooth clause.** When the plan's missing-tooth clause months are above 0, an estimate for a bridge, denture or implant that replaces a tooth extracted before the coverage effective date is payable only once the months of continuous enrollment, counted in whole calendar months from the coverage effective date to the issue date, reach the clause months. The clause does not apply to group enrollments entered at open enrollment, as new hires or by special enrollment. The extraction date is the one recorded on the person's most recently decided claim line for that tooth; where several claim lines for that tooth share that latest decision date this worksheet is not used, and a request for a replaced tooth whose most recently decided claim line records no extraction date is figured under the base rules. An estimate the clause still bars has an estimated plan payment of 0.00.

**F. Deductible.** The plan's individual deductible less the person's deductible postings net of deductible reversals for the issue date's benefit year, never below zero and never more than the allowance. A preventive-class service on a plan that waives the preventive deductible, or any service on a plan whose individual deductible is 0.00, takes none. Because every Cascade plan's family deductible maximum is three times its individual deductible, on an account with no more than three enrolled persons the family limit never falls below the person's own remaining deductible, so a requested estimate counts only the person's own deductible postings.

**G. Estimated normal benefit.** The allowance less the deductible taken, times the coinsurance, rounded to the cent with a half cent rounded up. The estimated plan payment and patient cost are rounded to the cent the same way.

**H. Annual maximum.** The estimated plan payment is never more than the person's remaining annual maximum for the issue date's benefit year: the plan's annual maximum less the person's maximum postings net of maximum reversals for that benefit year.

**I. Estimated patient cost.** The proposed fee less the estimated plan payment for an out-of-network practice, and the allowance less the estimated plan payment otherwise, never below zero. No other coverage is assumed to pay.

**J. Order.** The waiting-period and missing-tooth tests come first; then the coinsurance gives the estimated normal benefit; then the annual-maximum ceiling gives the estimated plan payment; the estimated patient cost is figured last from it.

### Worked estimate (hypothetical figures)
Basic-class procedure at an in-network practice; proposed fee 238.00, recorded allowance 214.65; group open-enrollment member (no waiting period); individual deductible 50.00 fully posted (net) for the year; out-of-network basic coinsurance 70 percent; remaining annual maximum 402.80.
- Allowance: the lesser of 238.00 and 214.65, which is 214.65.
- Deductible taken: none remains, 0.00.
- Estimated normal benefit: 214.65 times 70 percent, which is 150.255, rounded half up to 150.26.
- Estimated plan payment: 150.26 (within 402.80).
- Estimated patient cost: 214.65 less 150.26, which is 64.39.
